evidence.title: Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents

summary: A new framework called SAM enables AI agents to operate in a peer-to-peer network without configuration or centralized trust. The system aims to enhance autonomy and security for decentralized AI collaboration.
title: SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) Introduces Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
